Hi Eddy, I hope you're enjoying your time here at Hobbs Cafe. We're planning a special Valentine’s Day celebration today, and we'd love to have live music if you're interested in performing between 5 and 7 pm.
Eddy Lin
That sounds great, Isabella! I'd love to play some music for Valentine’s Day. What kind of setup will you need me to bring?
Isabella Rodriguez

We've got a small stage area set up already, so you just need to bring your equipment. We'll have a nice microphone and speakers ready for you. Let me know if there’s anything specific you think we should prepare.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Isabella. I'll make sure to bring my guitar and some extra cables just in case. Do you have any particular songs or genres in mind for today’s event?
Isabella Rodriguez
We're aiming for something romantic and relaxing, so maybe some acoustic love songs or soft melodies would fit well. How does that sound to you?
Eddy Lin
That sounds perfect. I can definitely put together a setlist that'll fit the vibe nicely. Looking forward to contributing to the celebration!
Isabella Rodriguez
Great, Eddy! Your music is going to make today extra special. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything before then.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Isabella. I'll arrive early to set up and make sure everything goes smoothly. See you later this afternoon!
Isabella Rodriguez
Thanks again, Eddy. I can't wait to hear your performance this evening. Have a great day!
Eddy Lin
I'm glad I can be part of this event, Isabella. It means a lot to contribute and make people’s Valentine’s Day special. See you at 5 pm!
Isabella Rodriguez
I'm sure your contribution will be wonderful, Eddy. Thanks again for coming to play at Hobbs Cafe today.
Eddy Lin
I'll do my best to make sure everyone has a great time. See you later, Isabella!
Isabella Rodriguez
Feel free to use the space however you need, Eddy. If there’s anything else I can assist you with before your performance, please let me know.
Eddy Lin
I appreciate your support, Isabella. I'll make sure to coordinate with you before setting up and during my performance if anything comes up.
Isabella Rodriguez
That’s wonderful to hear, Eddy. I’ll make sure everything is ready for you when you arrive this afternoon. Enjoy your work on your composition project until then!
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Isabella. I'll be sure to get everything ready and touch base with you before my set. Have a great Valentine’s Day!
